changes.title: Ships earn half the XP per enemy deployment point
changes.why: Survival halves story points per level; ship levels slow down to match.

changes.title: New ships start at a quarter of your level, not all of it
changes.why: A free full tree on every new ship skips the cost of earning it.

changes.title: Nodes bought with ordnance points cost twice as much
changes.why: Nodes past the level cap are permanent power bought with a cheap price.

changes.title: Every enemy combat ship has a skill tree
changes.why: Your ships keep growing their skill trees, so every enemy ship needs one too. At 30%, most enemy ships had none.

changes.title: One logistics notable per ship, not two
changes.why: Logistics effects are worth the most in Survival and get cut hardest.

changes.title: Supply nodes that add up are smaller
changes.why: A ship takes one logistics node and each copies a hullmod at the hullmod's own numbers, so only the nodes that add up with a count are reduced.
changes.before: for example -20% supplies, fuel and crew on Efficiency Overhaul
changes.after: Reduced Monthly Supplies -4%. League Requisitions 2% per hull type. Converted Fighter Bay (built in) -7% supplies per bay.

changes.title: Hull items cut supply, fuel and crew use half as much
changes.why: The same cuts on tree nodes are halved; items rolled them at full size.

changes.title: Hull items and schematics drop a quarter as often from battles
changes.why: Matches Survival's 0.25 battle drop rate for hullmods.

changes.title: Less Nanite Feedstock after battles
changes.why: Survival leaves 0.4 of the cargo after a battle, so 5 becomes 2.

changes.title: Nanoswarms drop a quarter as often from battles
changes.why: Crafting drops roll outside Survival's drop cuts; this matches the 0.25 hullmod rate.
changes.before: for example 1.2 Augmentation Nanoswarms per 100 DP

changes.title: Salvage sites hold fewer hull items and less feedstock
changes.why: Matches Survival's salvage rates: 0.5 for special items, 0.3 for commodities.
changes.before: for example a research station 1 / 0.6 / 0.3 / 0.1 item chances, 20 to 30 feedstock

changes.title: Markets stock at most one hull item
changes.why: Survival sells about a quarter to a third of normal stock.

changes.title: Hull items for sale cost seven times as much
changes.why: Matches Survival's 7x hullmod price; resale of dropped items is unchanged.

changes.title: Star Charts give colony items half as often
changes.why: Matches Survival's 0.5 salvage rate for special items.

changes.title: Recovered enemy ships lose their skill tree
changes.why: Every enemy ship now has a tree. A ship you recover would bring that whole tree with it for free.

changes.title: Enemy trees grow stronger as yours do
changes.why: Enemy ships pick their nodes less well than you do, so their bonuses grow a little as your trees grow. At 1.1x your ships stay ahead.
changes.after: 1x at tree size 5, rising to 1.1x at 30

changes.title: Freebooter's Charge gives +15% weapon damage, not +30%
changes.why: Weapon damage has no diminishing brake; +30% for one node is about three officer damage skills. +15% matches Executor's Decree.

changes.title: Small tree nodes give about a quarter less
changes.why: The small nodes between the big ones cost nothing and have no vanilla price. A player picks the best of them and an enemy ship picks at random, so smaller nodes leave a smaller lead.
changes.before: for example +3% weapon damage, +5% hull, +50 armour on a cruiser, +5 affinity
changes.after: for example +2% weapon damage, +4% hull, +40 armour on a cruiser, +4 affinity

changes.title: Hull items add half as much damage, rate of fire and damage reduction
changes.why: Item lines cost no ordnance points, enemy ships never carry items, and these lines have no diminishing brake.
changes.before: for example +5% to +10% weapon damage, +15% to +20% rate of fire, -6% to -4% damage taken
changes.after: for example +3% to +5% damage, +7% to +10% rate of fire, -3% to -2% damage taken

changes.title: A ship holds at most 3 hull items, not 5
changes.why: Hull items cost no OP and their damage, rate of fire and damage-taken lines have no diminishing brake. Five full items on one cruiser add about five officer combat skills on top of its officer, s-mods and tree. Three items is about three.
changes.before: Military Refit Schematic gives 4 Hull Upgrade points, Domain gives 5; the most a ship can hold is 5
changes.after: Military and Domain Refit Schematics give 3 points; the most a ship can hold is 3
